title: Cipher passage in a German report to Hesse-Kassel, Thirty Years' War (HStAM 4 d Nr. 1218 no. 49; DECODE R4500)

documents.shelfmark: Hessisches Staatsarchiv Marburg, HStAM 4 d Nr. 1218, no. 49; DECODE R4500

plaintext.source: Contemporary interlinear decipherment over cipher lines 1-4 only.

transcription.notes: --measure counts 654 including 64 word-space marks; 590 signs. Lines 1-2 cramped under a faded gloss.

system.summary: Letter substitution written mostly in digits (0-9) plus a few signs (theta, triangle, d-shaped sign, w-sign, crossed t, crossed 4); '12' written together is r; a few homophones (a: 5, A; s: 2, F).
system.sibling_key: none found; four sign alphabets of the same volume (R4467, R4491, R4520, R4525) do not fit

prior_solution.where: interlinear contemporary decipherment on lines 1-4 of the letter itself

conditions.human_role: Project-level: DECODE login cookie supplied, problem posed with /goal. No target-specific intervention.

solution.what: Fetched R4500 with the session cookie; one page, German clear letter with 14 cipher lines, interlinear gloss on lines 1-4.
First token transcription from line crops; misread the gloss/cipher alignment.
Many-to-one annealing on de-1500s without word spaces: letter-frequency noise only.
EM alignment of gloss 'das kann dieses orths selber observiren' to cipher line 3; inconsistent mappings.
Downloaded all 126 records of the volume (R4452-R4577); compared sign alphabets R4467, R4491, R4520, R4525.
Re-transcribed all 14 lines from mid-resolution views keeping word spaces.
Annealing with word spaces, '12' as one unit, seeded und/under; produced 'entschuldigt', 'damit ich', 'underthenigst'.
Fixed 5=a, q=m, D=l, 2=s, X=b by context; then M=w, 8=o from the gloss.
Gloss phrases 'zumahl nicht', 'etwas tentiret werden', 'dieses orths halber', 'dagegen' come out of lines 3-5 with the rebuilt key.
Read lines 3-14; lines 1-2 do not decode as transcribed.
Second pass on lines 1-2: restored dropped initial signs; line 2 reads, line 1 opens 'die landts...'.

outcome.method_basis: The substitution was rebuilt by homophonic annealing against a 1500s German model, seeded with repeated 'und'/'under' patterns; the contemporary interlinear gloss on cipher lines 1-4 of R4500 served as the control and fixed two values (M = w, 8 = o).
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading_tokens.txt: 538 cipher signs (12 joined = one), 17 marked ? unread

gaps.detail: cramped under a faded gloss on the only scan

outcome.notes: Report to Hesse-Kassel: matter passed to the Emperor and the Elector of Bavaria; writer asks to be held excused.
